definitions.explanation: A competition in which participants race to see who is the fastest, typically on foot. Used for track events, horse racing, and other speed competitions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{百|ひゃく}→百：00780_hyaku⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧{競走|きょうそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}した→出場する：20348_shutsujousuru⟧。
⟦{運動会|うんどうかい}→運動会：03013_undoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{競走|きょうそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一位|いちい}→一位：08926_ichii⟧になった。
examples.english: I came in first in the race at the sports day.

examples.japanese: {競走|きょうそう}{馬|ば}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦トレーニング→トレーニング：00408_toreeningu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早朝|そうちょう}→早朝：03109_souchou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Training of racehorses begins early in the morning.

notes:
USAGE:
{競走|きょうそう} refers specifically to racing (a speed contest), while the homophone ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧ means competition in a broader sense (business, academic, etc.). {競走|きょうそう} is used for athletic races and animal racing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {競走|きょうそう}{馬|ば} (racehorse)
- ⟦{短距離|たんきょり}→短距離：09270_tankyori⟧{競走|きょうそう} (sprint race)
- ⟦{長距離|ちょうきょり}→長距離：09271_choukyori⟧{競走|きょうそう} (long-distance race)
- ⟦{徒競走|ときょうそう}→徒競走：17220_tokyousou⟧ (footrace, running race at school events)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: competition (broader, not limited to racing)
- ⟦{徒競走|ときょうそう}→徒競走：17220_tokyousou⟧: footrace (specifically at school sports days)
- レース: race (loanword)
